name: Cross-Asset Credit-Regime Shield: equity credit/NFCI stress gates long crypto spot
rationale: Crypto spot carries high beta to broad equity/Nasdaq liquidity, and macro tightening (widening credit spreads, tightening NFCI financial conditions, a risk-off macro regime) transmits to crypto as a risk-off de-risking. Since we are long-only on spot, the only lever is WHEN to hold the long. The equity-macro credit regime is a CROSS-ASSET on/off switch: arm the crypto long only while credit_spread is tight (lt), NFCI is loose (lt), and the macro_regime composite reads risk-on (gt); require the equity tape to confirm via spx_index crossing UP (a DRIFTING raw level, so cross_up only, never a level cut). The edge hedge funds miss: crypto desks watch crypto-native signals (funding, on-chain) and equity desks watch credit — few systematically use the EQUITY credit regime as a tactical on/off gate for a long-only crypto SPOT book at the daily horizon. DISCONFIRMERS (mandatory): (1) the critical control — compare against gating on spx_index/ndx_index trend ALONE; if equity-price trend reproduces the protection, the credit/NFCI features add nothing and this is just 'follow equity beta', a level-in-disguise/momentum trade we reject. The credit+NFCI regime must add return BEYOND the equity price trend. (2) ablate vs crypto-native funding_rate de-risk — if funding alone protects equally, the cross-asset equity-macro claim is unsupported. (3) must beat buy-and-hold BTC/ETH net of 10bps spot taker fees on Sharpe/return, not merely reduce vol by being out on average. (4) credit_spread/nfci must be applied PIT (FRED/ALFRED initial-release vintage; weekly NFCI realtime_start) so no same-day look-ahead bleeds into the 24/7 crypto bar.
catalyst: Credit-led tightening (HY OAS widening, NFCI flipping positive) leads risk-asset drawdowns by ~1-3 months; flatten the long-only crypto book to cash when the equity credit regime arms hostile, re-arm when spreads tighten, NFCI re-loosens, and the SPX tape turns back up.
